caption: Lighthouse, Egmond aan Zee
composition: White round tower, grey lantern, and a low memorial base · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The lighthouse at Egmond aan Zee is a white tapered round tower with a grey lantern and a wide concrete watch room just beneath it. The base is a low memorial podium. The North Sea is dark. The sky is overcast, about 13.9°C, with wind near 7.9 km/h and cloud cover about 95%. The lamp is lit. The Katwijk and Noordwijk towers are different lights and are not in this frame.
